steps.name: Cleanser
steps.instructions: Massage onto damp skin for 30–60 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water.
steps.reason: A gentle cleanse is the foundation of both routines.

steps.name: Hydrating serum
steps.instructions: Press 2–3 drops into slightly damp skin before moisturizer.

steps.name: Moisturizer
steps.instructions: Warm a small amount between fingertips and press gently into skin.
steps.reason: Supports the skin barrier morning and night.

steps.name: Daily sunscreen
steps.instructions: Apply generously as the final morning step; reapply when outdoors.
steps.reason: Daytime UV protection belongs in every morning routine.
